9920651.description: A rich and creamy Thai-style soup prepared with tender chicken or seafood, fresh vegetables, mushrooms, and aromatic herbs, blended with a flavorful broth for a smooth, satisfying finish. Warm, comforting, and perfectly balanced with authentic Thai flavors.

9920669.name: GOLDEN SWEET CORN SOUP
9920669.description: A comforting blend of sweet corn, fresh vegetables, and a silky, flavorful broth, delicately seasoned with herbs and spices. Finished to perfection for a warm, creamy, and satisfying bowl that's loved by all ages.

9920673.name: THAI CLEAR SOUP
9920673.description: A light and aromatic Thai-style clear broth infused with garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and fresh herbs, featuring tender chicken or seafood, mushrooms, and crisp vegetables. Delicately seasoned for a refreshing, comforting, and authentic Thai flavor in every spoonful.

9920696.name: FRESH VEGETABLES SOUP
9920696.description: A wholesome blend of fresh seasonal vegetables simmered in a light, flavorful broth with aromatic herbs and delicate seasonings. Warm, nourishing, and naturally refreshing, it's the perfect choice for a healthy and comforting start to your meal.

9920752.name: HERB INFUSED CHICKEN VALENTINO
9920752.description: Herb Infused Chicken Valentino is an elegant, Italian-inspired dish designed to deliver bold, aromatic flavors and a beautiful presentation.

9920755.name: GOCHUJANG RED PEARL SEAFOOD
9920755.description:
The Flavor: A stunning interplay of sweet, savory, and spicy. The natural sweetness of the fresh seafood is elevated by the smoky, fermented complexity of the gochujang, finished with a hint of toasted sesame and a splash of bright citrus to cut the richness.
SPICY RICE

9920756.name: PINEAPPLE IMPERIAL RICE
9920756.description: Pineapple Imperial Rice is a spectacular, vibrant dish that brings a taste of tropical luxury to the table. Inspired by classic royal Thai cuisine, it combines fragrant jasmine rice, juicy pineapple, and a medley of savory proteins, all stir-fried to aromatic perfection.

9920757.name: OCEAN CHOCOLATE DORI FISH
9920757.description: The Flavor Intrigued guests will find a surprising harmony. The natural, clean taste of the dory fish acts as a perfect canvas. It is paired with a savory cocoa reduction that features earthy, bitter, and spiced notes completely steering clear of dessert-like sweetness.

9920762.name: RIBEYA RESERVE
9920762.description: The Ribeye Reserve is the ultimate expression of steak luxury a dish crafted for those who appreciate the finer nuances of a perfectly marbled, extraordinarily tender steak. Featuring a hand-selected, center-cut ribeye, this dish is aged, seasoned, and grilled to absolute perfection.

9920764.name: KING'S CUT T-BONE STEAK
9920764.description:
The King  Cut T-Bone Steak is a legendary centerpiece designed for the ultimate steak lover. This colossal, bone-in cut offers the best of both worlds: a rich, flavorful strip steak on one side of the bone, and an incredibly tender filet mignon on the other.

It is a true feast fit for royalty, prepared with meticulous attention to temperature, crust, and flavor.

9920814.name: ROZ SIRLOIN STEAK
9920814.description: steak, pan-seared to perfection in a bath of foaming French butter, fresh garlic cloves, and bruised rosemary. Finished with a melting dollop of our house-made herb butter.Served with: Crispy roasted baby potatoes and charred seasonal greens.The Vibe: "Rich, classic, and incredibly tender. A steakhouse favorite with an artisanal touch."

9920815.name: CLASSIC CROISSANT BEEF BACON
9920815.description:
The combination of flaky, buttery pastry and crispy, savory beef bacon is an absolute morning classic.

Here are three tempting ways to describe your Classic Croissant with Beef Bacon, tailored to fit different menu styles.

9920816.name: SMOKE CHICKEN CLUB
9920816.description:
The classic club sandwich is a crowd-pleaser, but upgrading it with tender, smoky chicken makes it a standout menu destination.

Here are three mouth-watering ways to frame your Smoked Chicken Club on your menu:

9920817.name: GRILL CHICKEN SANDWICH
9920817.description:
The Herbed Grill Chicken Sandwich
Fresh, bright, and packed with Mediterranean flavor.
Tender chicken breast marinated in garlic, lemon, and Italian herbs, grilled to juicy perfection over an open flame. Topped with melted provolone cheese, fresh beefsteak tomato, crisp baby arugula, and pickled red onions.

9920818.name: COASTAL TUNA MELT
9920818.description: Tuna Melt is the ultimate comfort classic, but giving it a "Coastal" twist elevates it from a standard diner lunch to a premium, fresh, and crave-able cafe signature. The key is emphasizing high-quality tuna, bright citrus notes, and perfectly melted, gooey cheese.

9922612.name: CLASSIC WALNUT BROWNIE
9922612.description: A rich, fudgy chocolate brownie baked with premium cocoa and crunchy roasted walnuts, served warm for the perfect balance of deep chocolate flavor and nutty goodness.

9923220.name: FLAT WHITE
9923220.description: The name comes from how the milk is prepared. In a cappuccino, the foam rises to form a puffy "dome." In a flat white, the microfoam is poured so that it sits perfectly flat on top of the espresso, resulting in a smooth, consistent sip from top to bottom

9923222.name: VANILLA LATTE
9923222.description:
A Vanilla Latte is a classic, comforting coffee house favorite that strikes a perfect balance between bold espresso, creamy steamed milk, and the sweet, aromatic flavor of vanilla. It is essentially a traditional caffè latte enhanced with vanilla syrup.

Here is a breakdown of what makes a vanilla latte so popular:

9923224.name: WHITE CHOCOLATE
9923224.description: In the coffee world, White Chocolate typically refers to the White Chocolate Mocha (often shortened to just "White Mocha"). It is a luxurious, dessert-like coffee drink that swaps traditional dark chocolate for sweet, creamy white chocolate.

9923240.name: CAPPUCCINO
9923240.description: A Cappuccino is one of the most famous and traditional espresso-based drinks in the world. Originating in Italy, it is beloved for its distinct, airy texture and the perfect, equal balance between strong coffee and creamy, frothy milk.

9923241.name: LATTE
9923241.description: A Latte (short for caffè latte, which translates to "milk coffee" in Italian) is the ultimate smooth and comforting coffee drink. It is the milkiest of all the classic espresso beverages, making it incredibly approachable, customizable, and a staple of coffee shops worldwide.

9923243.name: HAZELNUT LATTE
9923243.description: A Hazelnut Latte is a warm, aromatic coffee house favorite that infuses the classic caffè latte with the sweet, buttery, and distinctly nutty flavor of hazelnut. It is widely loved for its cozy, comforting taste profile that pairs beautifully with the natural roasted notes of espresso.

9923245.name: CARAMEL LATTE
9923245.description: A Caramel Latte is a sweet, indulgent coffee house favorite that combines the rich, bold taste of espresso with creamy steamed milk and the buttery, decadent flavor of caramel. It is the perfect choice for anyone who loves a dessert-like coffee with a warm, comforting finish.

9923254.name: DARK CHOCOLATE
9923254.description: In the coffee world, Dark Chocolate almost always refers to the classic Caffè Mocha (often simply called a Mocha). It is the ultimate crossover beverage marrying the rich, complex bitterness of a dark chocolate cocoa base with a bold shot of espresso and velvety milk.

9882224.description: Our Crispy Nachos are piled high with crunchy tortilla chips, gooey melted cheese, tender shredded chicken, zesty salsa, and fresh green onions. Every bite is bursting with bold flavors and the perfect crunch.

9882225.name: French Fries
9882225.description: Our French Fries are made from premium potatoes, cut to the perfect thickness and fried until perfectly golden and crispy. Lightly seasoned with salt, they're crunchy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and served hot and fresh.

9882226.name: Cheesy French Fries
9882226.description: Take your fries to the next level! Our Cheesy French Fries feature hot, golden crispy fries generously drizzled with our signature creamy cheese sauce. Every bite is the perfect mix of crunchy, salty, and cheesy goodness. A must-try comfort snack for all cheese lovers!

9882227.name: BBQ Cheesy Pop Chicken
9882227.description: Get ready for an explosion of flavor! Our BBQ Cheesy Pop Chicken features crispy, golden-brown chicken pops smothered in smoky BBQ sauce and topped with melted cheese. Each bite delivers the perfect crunch followed by gooey cheese pull and tangy BBQ kick. Garnished with fresh green onions for that extra zing. The ultimate crowd-pleaser!

9781555.name: BBQ Chicken Wings
9781555.description:
Get ready to get messy! Our BBQ Chicken Wings are slow-cooked and glazed in a smoky, sweet, and tangy BBQ sauce. Juicy on the inside, sticky on the outside — these wings are finger-lickin' good! 
Available in 4 Pcs, 8 Pcs & 12 Pcs.

9781556.name: Crispy Chicken Wings
9781556.description:
Get ready to get messy! Our Crisp Chicken Wings are slow-cooked and glazed in a smoky, sweet, and tangy BBQ sauce. Juicy on the inside, sticky on the outside — these wings are finger-lickin' good! 
Available in 4 Pcs, 8 Pcs & 12 Pcs.

9781557.name: Crispy Chicken Fry
9781557.description: Hear that crunch? Our Crispy Chicken Fry is golden, crunchy perfection on the outside with tender, juicy chicken on the inside. Marinated with our secret blend of spices and fried to a perfect crisp. One bite and you'll hear the crunch everyone craves!

9781558.name: BBQ Chicken Fry
9781558.description: Crispy meets saucy! Our BBQ Chicken Fry takes golden, crunchy fried chicken and drowns it in rich, smoky, sweet & tangy BBQ glaze. The perfect mix of crunch and sauce in every bite. Juicy inside, sticky outside — this is BBQ heaven!

9781559.name: Chicken Nugget
9781559.description: Bite-sized and impossible to resist! Our Chicken Nuggets are golden, crispy on the outside with tender, juicy chicken inside. Perfectly seasoned and fried to crunchy perfection. Dip, pop, and repeat — these nuggets are your go-to snack for any mood!

9781561.name: Beef Chowmein
9781561.description: For serious flavor seekers! Our Beef Chowmein is packed with juicy, wok-tossed beef strips, stir-fried noodles, and crunchy fresh veggies all coated in a rich, savory sauce. Bold, smoky, and absolutely addictive — this is chowmein taken to the next level!

9882228.name: Chicken Chow Mein
9882228.description: Our Chicken Chow Mein features perfectly wok-tossed noodles stir-fried with tender chicken, crisp fresh vegetables, and our signature savory sauce. Smoky, perfectly seasoned, and bursting with delicious flavor in every bite.

9784895.name: Stacked Curry Rice Platter
9784895.description: Double the chicken, double the fun! Our Stacked Curry Rice Platter brings you a juicy, sesame-topped glazed chicken steak AND a rich, flavorful chicken curry. Served with aromatic stacked fried rice and fresh cucumber slices. The perfect platter for true chicken lovers!

9882215.name: Stacked Rice Platter
9882215.description: Meet your new favorite: Stacked Rice Platter! A juicy, glazed chicken steak sprinkled with sesame seeds, served with fragrant stacked fried rice and crisp cucumber slices. Paired with our hot Chinese vegetable for that perfect restaurant-style taste. One platter, full of flavors!

9882216.name: BBQ Rice Bowl
9882216.description: Smoky, saucy, and satisfying! Our BBQ Rice Bowl is loaded with tender chicken chunks glazed in rich BBQ sauce, served alongside flavorful stacked fried rice. Paired with fresh cucumber slices for the perfect balance. Every bite is a burst of sweet and smoky goodness!

9882217.name: Chicken fry Rice platter
9882217.description: Crispy cravings sorted! Our Chicken Fry Rice Platter brings you a golden, crunchy fried chicken piece with a juicy inside. 9804383.description: Sichuan spicy chicken (commonly known as La Zi Ji or Chongqing chicken) is a fiery, aromatic dish featuring crispy chicken pieces wok-tossed with a massive amount of dried red chilies and tongue-tingling Sichuan peppercorns.

9878406.name: Chinese Chive & Eggs Stir Fry / 韭菜炒鸡蛋
9878406.description: hinese chives with eggs (韭菜炒鸡蛋) is a classic homestyle dish in Chinese cuisine. It features the distinct, savory-garlicky flavor of flat Chinese chives paired with tender, fluffy scrambled eggs. Quick and comforting, it perfectly embodies the essence of simple,

9774711.description: 1:1 - Mixed with special chinese seasoning, served cold

9788052.name: Classic Fried Chicken / 炸鸡
9788052.description: Classic fried chicken, often known as Southern-style, features broiler chicken pieces coated in seasoned flour or batter, deep-fried or pan-fried to a deep golden-brown.

9788058.name: Classic Fried Chicken wings / 炸鸡翼
9788058.description: Two pieces of classic fried chicken wings are a popular, quick appetizer or snack featuring chicken wing sections (typically one drumette and one flat) that are battered or breaded and deep-fried until golden brown.

9788059.name: Taifeng Fried Chicken (避風塘雞)
9788059.description: Taifeng fried chicken is characterized as a "from-scratch" dish featuring a buttermilk-marinated, golden, and crispy exterior with juicy meat.

9788065.name: Taifeng Fried chicken wings (避风塘鸡翼)
9788065.description: Taifeng chicken wings are a famous Hong Kong-style dish characterized by deep-fried chicken wings tossed in a fragrant, crunchy mixture of fermented black beans, abundant garlic, dried chilies, and panko breadcrumbs. This dish is inspired by traditional fisherman cuisine, delivering a savory, spicy, and deeply aromatic flavor profile

9788076.name: Flamy Fried chicken / 辣子鸡
9788076.description: Flamy Fried Chicken is a intensely spicy, crunchy, and vibrant red-orange fried chicken characterized by a bold coating of cayenne pepper, chili powder, and paprika. It features a deeply crispy exterior, often achieved through seasoned flour mixed with cornstarch or crushed hot chips, covering a moist, spicy-marinated interior.

9788079.name: Flamy fried chicken Wings / 炸雞翅
9788079.description: Flamy fried chicken wings are characterized by a fiery, blistering crunch, usually featuring a thin, shatter-crisp skin seasoned with intense spices. Often double-fried for maximum crunch, these wings are juicy on the inside, typically seasoned with cayenne pepper, paprika, and garlic to deliver a lingering "flame" or "hot" kick, say the insights from.

9788080.name: Xiangla Fried Chicken / 辣子鸡
9788080.description: Xiangla fried chicken, commonly known as is a signature Sichuan dish characterized by crispy, bite-sized chicken pieces buried under a "mountain" of dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, and aromatics. It is a mala (numbing and spicy) dish that aroma and flavor rather than heavy, thick batter.

9788085.name: Xiangla Fried chicken wings / 香辣炸鸡翅
9788085.description: Xiangla fried chicken wings (香辣鸡翅) are a vibrant Sichuan-style dish known for being crispy, hot, and numbing. They are typically deep-fried until crunchy and then stir-fried or tossed with a mix of dried chili peppers, Sichuan peppercorns, and aromatics like garlic and ginger, creating a "dry-fried" texture that is intensely flavorful.

9792842.name: Classic Chicken strips / 鸡柳
9792842.description: Chicken strips are slices of chicken meat, typically from the breast or tenderloin, that are breaded and deep-fried or baked until golden brown. Often served as a popular appetiser or main course with dipping sauces, they are similar to chicken tenders but generally represent wider, hand-cut pieces rather than the specific, smaller pectoral muscle known as the tenderloin.

9792843.name: Flamy Chicken Strips / 辣子鸡
9792843.description: Flamy (or "Flaming Hot") chicken strips are breaded, tender white-meat chicken breast fillets, coated in a spicy, crunchy chilli seasoning, often including paprika and red pepper. They feature a fiery, vibrant red exterior with a crispy texture and a juicy, seasoned interior.

9792863.name: Taifeng Chicken Strips / 炸雞排
9792863.description: Taifeng Chicken Strips (often referred to as Crispy Chicken Cutlet or Fried Chicken Cutlet) are a popular, world-renowned menu item featuring tender, boneless chicken strips that are coated in a light, crunchy batter and deep-fried to a golden brown.

9813944.name: Suan Fried Chicken Full Leg / 蒜香炸雞脾
9813944.description: A Chinese Suan Fried chicken full leg features a bone-in, skin-on chicken leg quarter that is first braised in a savory, aromatic soy sauce broth and then flash-fried. The result is a tender, deeply flavorful dark meat with an incredibly crispy, shiny, and golden-brown exterior.

9814010.name: Suan Fried Chicken Wings / 蒜香炸鸡翅
9814010.description: Suan fried chicken wings are celebrated for their shattering crispiness, light craggy skin, and savory, umami-rich flavor. They are typically marinated in a blend of soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and Asian aromatics, then double-fried to achieve a juicy interior and highly distinct, addictive crunch.

9814652.name: Pop’s Chicken / 盐酥鸡
9814652.description: commonly known as popcorn chicken- are small, bite-sized chunks of boneless chicken that are seasoned, coated in flour or breadcrumbs, and deep-fried until golden and crispy.

9424473.name: Thai Fried Chicken

Thai Fried Chicken (Premium)

Our Premium Thai Fried Chicken is crafted with authentic Thai spices and fresh ingredients for an unforgettable taste. Marinated in a signature blend of garlic, coriander root, white pepper, and aromatic herbs, the chicken is slow-infused for deep flavor, then fried to golden perfection. The result is an irresistibly crispy exterior with juicy, tender meat inside. Lightly seasoned for balance, not heaviness, it delivers a rich, savory aroma with a subtle Thai spice finish. Perfect as a standalone indulgence or paired with dipping sauce, this premium delight offers restaurant-quality taste in every bite.

4364061.name: Prawn Tempura
4364061.description: 6 pcs - Prawn tempura is a Japanese dish featuring prawns coated in a light, crispy batter and deep-fried until golden brown. Served with a dipping sauce, it's known for its delightful contrast of crunchy exterior and tender, juicy prawn inside.

4364062.name: Mixed Tempura
4364062.description: 6 pcs - Mixed tempura is a Japanese dish featuring a variety of ingredients like vegetables and seafood coated in a light tempura batter and deep-fried until golden and crispy. Served with dipping sauce, it offers a delightful contrast of textures and flavors.

4364064.name: Chicken Dumpling
4364064.description: 6 pcs - Chicken dumplings are savory parcels filled with ground chicken, vegetables, and seasonings, encased in a thin dough wrapper. Whether steamed, boiled, or pan-fried, these dumplings offer a flavorful and tender bite, commonly enjoyed as appetizers or snacks in various Asian cuisines.

4364060.name: Fried Chicken
4364060.description: 7 pcs - Fried Chicken, known for its crispy texture, is double-fried and coated in a sweet and spicy glaze or soy-based sauce. This popular dish offers a delightful combination of crunchy skin, juicy meat, and flavorful sauce

4364063.name: Beef Dumpling
4364063.description:
6 pcsn - 
Beef dumplings are savory parcels filled with seasoned ground beef and vegetables, encased in a thin dough wrapper. Whether steamed, boiled, or pan-fried, these dumplings offer a delicious combination of flavorful filling and tender texture, commonly enjoyed as appetizers or snacks in various cuisines.

4364100.name: California with Ebiko
4364100.description: 6 pcs - The California Roll topped with ebiko features a classic California Roll a combination of crab or imitation crab, avocado, and cucumber enhanced with a layer of ebiko (fish roe) on top. This addition adds a burst of briny flavor and a pleasing pop of texture to the familiar California Roll. Enjoyed with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, it offers a delightful twist to the traditional roll.

4364097.name: Chicken Breast Tender Roll
4364097.description: 6 pcs - The Chicken Breast Tender Roll is a sushi roll that highlights thinly sliced, tender chicken breast as the main ingredient. This roll typically features vinegared rice, nori, and may include additional elements like vegetables or avocado for added texture and flavor. Served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, the Chicken Breast Tender Roll provides a unique and savory twist to traditional sushi options.

4364119.name: Crispy Prawn Tempura Roll
4364119.description: 6 pcs - Crispy Prawn Tempura Roll: Golden-fried prawn, creamy avocado, and crispy egg in a roll, topped with cheese and breadcrumbs. Served with honey mustard sauce for a perfect blend of flavors and textures. Enjoy this unique and delicious experience!

4364110.name: Green Dragon Roll
4364110.description: 6 pcs - The Green Dragon Roll is a sushi delight with a layer of avocado, mayo, and ebiko. Inside, it features fried prawn, cheese, avocado, and cucumber for a harmonious blend of textures and flavors. Enjoyed with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, it's a visually appealing and delicious choice.

4364116.name: Chicken Teriyaki Roll
4364116.description: 6 pcs - Chicken Teriyaki Roll: Tender teriyaki-glazed chicken strips rolled with sushi rice, seaweed, and fresh ingredients like avocado and cucumber. A sweet and savory delight, served with soy sauce for a satisfying flavor combination.

4364099.name: Crispy California Roll
4364099.description: 6 pcs - The Fried Crab Stick and Avocado Roll is filled with crispy crab stick and creamy avocado, topped with a layer of crunchy crab. This sushi roll offers a delightful contrast of textures and flavors, combining the savory crunch with the richness of avocado and the fried crab stick. Enjoy with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a tasty experience.

4364104.name: Torched Crab with Salmon
4364104.description: 6 pcs - The Torched Crab with Salmon Roll is a flavorful sushi creation filled with salmon and avocado, wrapped in sushi rice. Topped with a layer of crab meat mixed with mayonnaise, the roll is then carefully torched, creating a savory and visually appealing dish. The torching adds a smoky touch to the crab and enhances the overall taste of the roll.

4364103.name: Lava Roll
4364103.description: 6 pcs - The Lava Roll is a sushi delight filled with fried prawn, cheese, and avocado. Topped with spicy mayo sauce, it undergoes torching for a visually striking effect, resembling lava cascading down. This roll offers a perfect balance of textures and flavors, with the torched presentation adding a touch of drama to the dish.

4364109.name: Spicy California Roll
4364109.description: 6 pcs - The Spicy California Roll is a classic sushi variation, filled with crab, avocado, and cucumber. It stands out with a spicy kick from mayo or a spicy sauce, providing a flavorful twist. Served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a complete experience.

4364113.name: Tiger Roll
4364113.description: 6 pcs - Tiger Roll: Experience the bold fusion of flavors with our Tiger Roll a tantalizing blend of creamy cheese, ripe avocado, crispy fried prawn, and refreshing cucumber. Crowned with a luscious drizzle of honey mustard sauce and a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), this roll harmonizes perfectly for an exquisite balance of textures and tastes.

4364107.name: Torched Salmon Roll
4364107.description: 6 pcs - The Torched Salmon Roll is a sushi delight with crab stick and fresh salmon inside. Torched for a smoky flavor, it offers a unique blend of textures and tastes. Served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, it's a delicious and satisfying choice.

4364096.name: Halofina Fire Cracker
4364096.description: 6 pcs - Halofina Fire Cracker is a sushi roll featuring tuna, salmon, green chili, and avocado. The combination delivers a spicy kick from the chili, paired with the richness of the fish and creaminess of avocado. This flavorful roll, with vinegared rice and nori, is a delightful blend of textures and tastes. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a complete experience.

4364098.name: Wild Forest Roll
4364098.description: 6 pcs - The Oil Forest Roll features a blend of salmon, tuna, avocado, and cheese, wrapped in crisp lettuce. This sushi roll offers a unique combination of flavors, combining the richness of the fish with the creaminess of avocado and a fresh, crisp texture from the lettuce. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a delightful and distinctive sushi experience.

4364101.name: Beef Kim Bap
4364101.description: 6 pcs - Beef kimbap is a Korean dish that consists of seasoned beef, vegetables, and pickled radish wrapped in sheets of seaweed and rice. The ingredients are rolled tightly into a cylinder and sliced into bite-sized pieces. This savory and satisfying dish is often served with soy sauce for dipping, providing a flavorful combination of beef, vegetables, and rice in each bite.

4364102.name: Beef Roaster Roll
4364102.description:
6 pcs - 
The Beef Roaster Roll is a decadent treat with large beef kima, cheese, and avocado inside. Coated in egg and breadcrumbs, it's fried to a crispy texture and served with sweet mayo sauce, offering a delicious blend of flavors and crunch.

4364105.name: Salmon Rose
4364105.description:
6 pcs - 
Salmon Rose Sushi features a thin slice of fresh salmon draped over vinegared rice, creating an elegantly simple and delicious bite. Served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a delightful flavor balance.

4364106.description: 6 pcs - The Sumo Roll features a generous blend of tuna, salmon, crab stick, and avocado inside, topped with ebiko for added flavor. This sushi roll offers a satisfying combination of textures and tastes, making it a delightful choice for sushi enthusiasts.

4364108.name: Red Dragon
4364108.description: 6 pcs -The Red Dragon Roll boasts a core of fried prawn, cheese, and avocado, topped with layers of tuna kima and crab meat. This visually striking sushi roll offers a rich and satisfying combination of textures and flavors.

4364111.name: Hot Night Roll
4364111.description: 6 pcs - The Hot Night Roll is a dynamic sushi roll featuring a filling of fried prawn, cheese, avocado, and cucumber. The roll is elevated with a torched layer of tuna kima on top, generously drizzled with spicy mayo sauce. This roll offers a delightful contrast of textures and a spicy kick, creating a flavorful and visually appealing sushi experience.

4364112.name: Rainbow California Roll
4364112.description: 6 pcs - A Rainbow California Sushi Roll is a variation of the classic California roll, featuring a base of crab or imitation crab, avocado, and cucumber. The roll is then topped with vibrant slices of salmon and tuna, creating a colorful and flavorful combination.

4364114.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
4364114.description: 6 pcs - Spicy Salmon Roll: Enjoy the exhilarating kick of our Spicy Salmon Roll, featuring fresh salmon, spicy mayo, and cucumber rolled in seaweed and rice. Topped with a sprinkle of sesame seeds and green onions, this roll delivers a perfect balance of heat and freshness. Served with soy sauce, it's a deliciously fiery addition to your sushi experience.

4364122.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
4364122.description: 6 pcs - Spicy Tuna Roll: Indulge in the bold flavors of our Spicy Tuna Roll, where fresh tuna, spicy mayo, and cucumber come together in a perfect harmony of heat and freshness. Rolled in seaweed and rice, this classic offers a delightful kick to your sushi experience.

4364121.name: Maguro Katsu Maki
4364121.description: 6 pcs - Maguro Katsu Maki : Dive into the ultimate tuna experience. Packed with tuna katsu, both inside and on top, this roll offers a rich blend of deep-fried succulence. Enhanced with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, and seasoned rice, it's a symphony of satisfying flavors and textures.

4364120.name: Dragon Eye
4364120.description: 6 pcs - Dragon Eye Roll: Immerse yourself in the captivating flavors of our Dragon Eye Roll. Inside, a delightful ensemble of boiled shrimp, tuna, creamy avocado, succulent salmon, and crab stick harmonize for a symphony of textures. Crowned with a tantalizing drizzle of spicy mayo sauce, a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), and a touch of sesame seeds, this roll is an exquisite feast for the senses.

4364118.name: Sweet Tiger Roll
4364118.description: 6 pcs - Sweet Tiger Roll: A decadent delight featuring a filling of creamy cheese, crispy fried prawn, and avocado. Topped with a luscious drizzle of sweet soy sauce and a satisfying crunch, this roll skips the nori for a unique twist on texture and flavor.

4364086.name: Torched Salmon Nigiri
4364086.description: 6 pcs Torched salmon nigiri features a small bed of vinegared rice topped with fresh salmon that has been gently torched or seared. The torching process imparts a smoky flavor and adds a slightly crispy texture to the outer layer of the salmon, while keeping the inside tender. This nigiri is often served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, providing a harmonious blend of warmth and freshness.

4364084.name: Torched Tuna Nigiri
4364084.description: 6 pcs - Torched Tuna Nigiri features a piece of vinegared rice topped with fresh tuna that has been delicately seared or torched. The slight charring enhances the flavor of the tuna, creating a balance between the warm, smoky exterior and the cool, tender interior. This nigiri is often served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a delightful blend of textures and flavors.

4364080.name: Tuna Nigiri
4364080.description: 6 pcs - Tuna Nigiri: A classic Japanese sushi featuring vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh tuna. Simple and flavorful, it highlights the quality of the ingredients in a single, hand-held bite.

4364087.name: Salmon Nigiri
4364087.description: 6 pcs - Salmon nigiri consists of bite-sized mounds of vinegared rice topped with thin slices of fresh salmon. The simplicity of this sushi allows the rich and buttery flavor of the salmon to shine. Typically served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, salmon nigiri offers a delicious and classic sushi experience.

4364085.name: Shrimp Nigiri
4364085.description: 6 pcs - Shrimp nigiri consists of bite-sized mounds of vinegared rice topped with fresh, cooked shrimp. The shrimp is often peeled and placed on the rice, creating a simple and delicious sushi bite. It is typically served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, offering a delightful combination of flavors and textures.

4364081.name: Mixed Nigiri
4364081.description: 6 pcs - Mixed nigiri with salmon, tuna, and shrimp is a delicious sushi option. Form bite-sized oblong rice mounds, top with thinly sliced fresh salmon or tuna, and place a whole cooked shrimp on others. Optionally, wrap shrimp with nori. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a delightful and diverse sushi experience.

4364079.name: Tuna Maki
4364079.description:
6 pcs - 
Tuna Maki: A classic sushi roll with seasoned rice, nori, and fresh tuna filling. Rolled and sliced into bite-sized pieces, it provides a satisfying combination of tender tuna and vinegared rice, commonly served with soy sauce and wasabi.

4364082.name: Salmon Maki
4364082.description: 6 pcs - Salmon maki is a sushi roll featuring a layer of seasoned rice and thin slices of fresh salmon, cucumber, and avocado rolled in nori (seaweed). The roll is sliced into bite-sized pieces and served with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for a delicious and balanced sushi experience.

4364078.name: Egg Maki
4364078.description: 6 pcs - Egg Maki is a sushi roll featuring seasoned rice, nori, and a sweetened rolled omelette filling. Additional ingredients like cucumber or avocado may be included for added texture, offering a delightful balance of sweet and savory flavors.

4364067.name: Salmon Sashimi
4364067.description: 5 pcs Fresh, tender slices of raw salmon, delicately seasoned, offering a melt-in-your-mouth experience with rich, buttery flavor

4364065.name: Tuna Sashimi
4364065.description: 5 pcs Fresh, thinly sliced tuna, delicately seasoned, served raw with soy sauce & wasabi for a pure, savory flavor

4364066.name: Mixed Sashimi
4364066.description: 10 pcs - Prepared with salmon, tuna & avocado

4364092.name: Salmon Avocado Salad
4364092.description: 1:1  - Salmon Avocado Salad is a refreshing and nutritious dish that typically features fresh salmon, avocado, and mixed greens. The salmon is often grilled or smoked, adding a rich and flavorful element to the salad. Served with slices of creamy avocado, the salad may include additional ingredients like cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and a light vinaigrette dressing.

4364088.name: Wakame Seaweed Salad
4364088.description: 1:1 - Wakame Seaweed Salad is a traditional Japanese dish known for its refreshing taste and nutritional benefits. The salad features wakame, a type of edible seaweed, typically rehydrated and seasoned with ingredients like soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and sometimes sesame seeds. Additional elements like cucumber or thinly sliced radishes may be added for extra crunch and flavor. Wakame Seaweed Salad is popular for its light and savory profile, making it a delightful side dish or appetizer in Japanese cuisine.

4364089.name: Salmon Tartar Salad
4364089.description: 1:1 - Salmon Tartar Salad is a gourmet dish that showcases fresh and finely diced salmon, often combined with ingredients like avocado, red onion, capers, and dill. The salmon is typically seasoned with ingredients like lemon juice, olive oil, and salt to enhance its flavor.

4364091.name: Honey Mustard Chicken Salad
4364091.description: 1:1 - Honey Mustard Chicken Salad: Grilled or roasted chicken over mixed greens, glazed with a sweet and tangy honey mustard dressing. This salad offers a delightful balance of flavors, with crisp vegetables enhancing the tender chicken for a satisfying meal.

4364090.name: Tuna Tartar Salad
4364090.description: 1:1 - Tuna Tartar Salad: Finely diced fresh tuna combined with avocado, cucumber, red onion, and sesame seeds. Seasoned with a zesty dressing featuring soy sauce, sesame oil, and lime juice, this salad offers a sophisticated blend of textures and flavors, served over mixed greens or with crispy wonton chips for a refreshing and visually appealing dish.

4364071.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
4364071.description: 1:1 - Spicy Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Thinly sliced chicken marinated in a spicy bulgogi sauce, stir-fried, and served over steamed rice. Garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, this bowl provides a flavorful and satisfying combination of spicy and savory goodness.

4364068.name: Spicy BBQ Seafood
4364068.description: 1:1 - Spicy Seafood Bulgogi: A zesty dish with marinated shrimp, squid and seafood in spicy bulgogi sauce. Stir-fried and served over steamed rice, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, it provides a flavorful and satisfying blend of spicy and savory seafood goodness.

4364069.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
4364069.description: 1:1 - Spicy Beef Bulgogi is a mouthwatering dish featuring thinly sliced beef marinated in a spicy bulgogi sauce. The beef is stir-fried until cooked and served over a bed of steamed rice. With a kick of heat, this dish combines the tender and flavorful beef with the bold flavors of the spicy bulgogi marinade.

4364093.name: Miso Soup
4364093.description: 1:1 - Miso soup is a traditional Japanese soup made with dashi (a broth made from fish and seaweed), miso paste, tofu, seaweed, and often includes ingredients like green onions or vegetables. The result is a flavorful and savory soup with a rich umami taste. Miso soup is a staple in Japanese cuisine and is commonly enjoyed as a starter or side dish in meals.

4364094.name: Seafood Clear Soup
4364094.description: 1:1 - Seafood Clear Soup: A light and flavorful broth-based soup with assorted seafood like shrimp and fish. Clear broth seasoned with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and green onions, and often featuring vegetables like mushrooms or bok choy. This soup offers a clean taste and a delightful combination of seafood and aromatic broth, perfect as a starter or light meal.

4364095.name: Jjam Pong Seafood Noodles Soup
4364095.description:
1:1 - 
Jjamppong is a Korean spicy seafood noodle soup that features a rich and flavorful broth, filled with a variety of seafood such as shrimp, mussels, and squid. The soup is often seasoned with gochugaru (Korean red chili flakes) and gochujang (Korean red chili paste), providing a spicy kick. Vegetables like onions, carrots, and cabbage are commonly included, creating a hearty and satisfying noodle soup that's popular in Korean cuisine.

4364073.name: Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl
4364073.description: 1:1 - Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Thinly sliced chicken marinated in savory bulgogi sauce, stir-fried, and served over steamed rice. Garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, it offers a flavorful and satisfying combination of tender chicken and Korean-inspired goodness.

4364074.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
4364074.description: 1:1 - Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Marinated shrimp, squid and assorted seafood stir-fried in savory bulgogi sauce, served over steamed rice. Garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, this dish offers a delightful combination of tender and flavorful seafood with Korean-inspired flair for a satisfying meal.

3069685.name: Fried Chicken Wings
3069685.description: 10 pcs - Crafted with precision , our korean fried chicken features tender , double fried chicken pieces coated in a luscious blend of soy sauce , garlic ginger and sesame oil.

3069686.name: Chicken Yakitori
3069686.description: 5 Sticks - Chicken yakitori is a Japanese dish of skewered and grilled chicken, brushed with a sweet soy-based sauce. Cooked over charcoal, the result is a delightful blend of smoky, tender chicken with a caramelized glaze.

3069687.name: Kimchi Jeon
3069687.description: Korean Pan Fried Kimchi Pan Cake made with fresh kimchi , seafood , eggs and vegetables.

3069688.name: Prawn Tempura with Crum
3069688.description: 6 pcs -  Made with Large Tiger Prawn & double fried with bread cram .

3069689.name: Calamari Ring
3069689.description: Deep fried Calamari Ring served with Tempura sauce .

3069690.name: Vegetable Tempura
3069690.description: Mixed Vegetable fried with  secret sauce and served with Tempura sauce .

3069691.name: Chicken Nan Bun
3069691.description: Crispy Chicken ( Leg meat ) dressed with special Nan Ban Sauce & Fresh Vegetables.

3069693.name: Bangkok Fried Chicken
3069693.description: 7 pcs - This Double fried crispy Chicken marinated with secret sauce served with Tomato Sauce .

3069694.name: Egg Roll
3069694.description: 8 Slices - Rolled with Egg and fresh Vegetables fried with secret Spcices. Served with Tepura sauce .

3069695.name: Chicken Cheese Roll
3069695.description: 6 pcs - Roll up with cheese , Chicken Breast & Depp fried with Bread - Crum.

4255464.name: Fish Finger
4255464.description: Fish fingers are bite-sized portions of breaded and usually baked or fried white fish fillets. Convenient and versatile, they are commonly served with dipping sauces and enjoyed as a quick and tasty snack or meal.

4257207.name: Mixed Tempura
4257207.description: Japananese traditional dish - Made with Prawn , Squid  & Vegetables .

3069710.name: Fish Cutlet
3069710.description: 8 slices - Made with fish , vegetables & spices .Coated in Eggs & breadcrumbs.

3069701.name: Mixed Seafood Clear Soup
3069701.description: Mixed seafood clear soup is a light and flavorful broth with a variety of fresh seafood, such as shrimp, squid, octopus and fish. The clear broth, possibly seasoned with herbs and spices, highlights the delicate natural flavors of the seafood, creating a savory and refreshing soup.

3069700.name: Vegetable Clear Soup
3069700.description: Vegetable clear soup is a light and nutritious broth filled with a medley of colorful vegetables. With a clear broth seasoned with herbs and spices, it offers a refreshing and healthful option that showcases the natural flavors of the veggies.

3069702.name: Miso Soup
3069702.description: Miso soup is a classic Japanese dish featuring a savory broth made from dashi and miso paste. Tofu, seaweed, and green onions are common additions, creating a simple yet comforting and flavorful soup, often enjoyed as a light meal or appetizer.

3069699.name: Hamol Thang
3069699.description: For 2 people - Spicy mixed seafood soup

3069697.name: Thai Soup
3069697.description: 1:2 - Thai soup is a collection of flavorful and aromatic soups from Thailand, known for their unique blend of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy flavors. Popular varieties include Tom Yum, a hot and sour soup, and Tom Kha Gai, a coconut milk-based soup with chicken.

3069713.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
3069713.description: Spicy beef bulgogi is a Korean dish with thinly sliced beef marinated in a spicy mix of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, garlic, ginger, and sugar. Stir-fried or grilled, it offers a bold and fiery twist to the traditional bulgogi, perfect for a flavorful meal served with rice and vegetables.

4257217.name: Beef Teriyaki
4257217.description: Beef teriyaki is a Japanese dish where thinly sliced beef is marinated and glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. Grilled or pan-seared, it delivers a delicious combination of caramelized and tender beef, often served over rice or with vegetables.

3069719.name: Chicken Chilli Onion
3069719.description: Chicken Chili Onion, or Chilli Chicken, is a popular Indo-Chinese dish celebrated across India. It involves crispy fried chicken tossed in a spicy, tangy chili sauce, creating a fiery flavor. Prepared with onions, ginger, garlic, and flavorful sauces

3069705.name: Prawn Garlic
3069705.description: Prawn garlic is a flavorful dish featuring prawns cooked or sautéed with garlic, creating a rich and savory taste. Often simple yet delicious, it's celebrated for the delightful combination of seafood and the aromatic essence of garlic.

3069707.name: Beef Chili Onion
3069707.description: Beef Chili Onion, or Chilli Beef, is a popular Indo-Chinese dish in India. Tender beef, crisped and coated in a spicy, tangy chili sauce with onions, ginger, garlic, and assorted sauces. Enjoy it restaurant-style, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

3069711.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
3069711.description: 1:1 - picy chicken bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring thinly sliced chicken marinated in a spicy mix of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, garlic, ginger, and sugar. Stir-fried or grilled, it provides a bold and fiery twist to the traditional bulgogi, creating a flavorful meal served with rice and vegetables.

3069718.name: Chicken Kkanpunggi
3069718.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi is a popular Korean-Chinese dish featuring deep-fried chicken stir-fried with a spicy and garlicky sauce. It combines crispy chicken with savory and spicy flavors, often including vegetables. Enjoyed as a main dish, it pairs well with rice or noodles.

3069712.name: Prawn Tangsu
3069712.description: 1:1 - Prawn tangsu is a Korean dish featuring fish cooked in a sweet and sour sauce. The prawn is typically fried or breaded, and the tangsu sauce imparts a delightful balance of sweetness and tanginess to the dish.

3069715.name: Teriyaki Chicken
3069715.description: Chicken teriyaki is a Japanese dish with bite-sized chicken glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. Whether grilled, baked, or pan-seared, it yields juicy, flavorful chicken with a caramelized finish.

3069717.name: Fish Tangsu
3069717.description: Fish tangsu is a Korean dish featuring fish cooked in a sweet and sour sauce. The fish is typically fried or breaded, and the tangsu sauce imparts a delightful balance of sweetness and tanginess to the dish.

4257212.name: Octopus BBQ
4257212.description: Korean-style octopus BBQ  involves grilling small octopus in a spicy gochujang-based sauce with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar. Known for its sweet, savory, and spicy flavors, this dish offers a unique and bold taste experience. Enjoyed with rice and side dishes, it's a popular choice in Korean seafood barbecue.

4257215.name: Squid BBQ
4257215.description: Korean-style squid BBQ features grilled or stir-fried squid in a gochujang-based sauce with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar. Balancing sweet, savory, and spicy flavors, it highlights the tender texture of the squid. A favorite in Korean barbecue, it's served with rice and side dishes for a unique and bold taste experience.

4257219.name: Crab Curry
4257219.description: Crab curry is a delightful dish featuring crab cooked in a flavorful curry sauce with spices, herbs, and aromatics like ginger, garlic, onions, and tomatoes.

7966590.name: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi
7966590.description: Spicy seafood bulgogi is a Korean delight featuring a mix of shrimp, squid, and octopus  marinated in a spicy-sweet blend of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and black pepper

4257214.name: Kimchi Fried Rice with Beef
4257214.description: Plain rice stir-fried with kimchi & basic seasonings

4257218.name: Chicken Fried Rice
4257218.description: A signature & must have with all chinese items

9830220.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
9830220.description: 1:1 - Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Grilled marinated seafood over steamed rice, a fusion of savory and marine flavors Topped with sesame seeds and green onions for a quick and delightful Korean twist

9830222.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl
9830222.description: 1:1 - Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Succulent grilled beef bulgogi served over steamed rice, offering a delightful blend of sweet and savory flavors Topped with sesame seeds and green onions, it's a quick and satisfying Korean culinary delight

4257213.name: Salmon Sashimi
4257213.description: 5 pcs slice - Salmon sashimi is a Japanese delicacy showcasing fresh, thinly sliced raw salmon. Often served as an appetizer or part of a sushi platter, it highlights the tender texture and rich flavor of the salmon. Accompanied by soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, salmon sashimi offers a delightful and pure seafood experience.

4257216.name: Tuna Sashimi
4257216.description: 5 slice - Tuna sashimi is a Japanese dish featuring fresh, thinly sliced raw tuna. Served as an appetizer or part of a sushi platter, it highlights the tuna's texture and flavor. Accompanied by soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, tuna sashimi is celebrated for its simplicity and the purity of the fish

3069740.name: Beef Maki
3069740.description: 6 pcs - Beef maki is a sushi roll made with cooked beef as a central ingredient. Alongside vinegared rice and seaweed, this variation introduces a savory twist to traditional sushi. The roll may include other complementary ingredients, offering a diverse flavor profile

3069739.name: Salmon Maki
3069739.description: 6 pcs -  Salmon maki is a sushi roll with vinegared rice, seaweed, and fresh salmon. This classic combination highlights the rich and tender flavor of the salmon, making it a popular and delicious choice among sushi options

3069738.name: Cucumber Maki
3069738.description: 6 pcs - Cucumber maki is a light and refreshing sushi roll with vinegared rice, seaweed, and cucumber as the main filling.

4257210.name: Tuna Maki
4257210.description: 6 pcs - Tuna maki is a classic sushi roll featuring vinegared rice, seaweed, and fresh tuna. Often complemented with ingredients like cucumber, avocado, or spicy mayo, it's a popular and flavorful choice in Japanese cuisine

3069734.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
3069734.description: 6 pcs Delicate rice topped with fresh tuna, served with wasabi & soy sauce for dipping

3069736.name: Salmon Sushi Nigiri
3069736.description: A type of sushi featuring a slice of raw salmon over a small bed of vinegared rice.

9830224.name: Mixed Nigiri
9830224.description:
"1:1 -  Nigiri sushis consisting of shrimp, salmon, tuna 
& cuttlefish"

3069750.name: Maguro Katsu Maki
3069750.description: 6 pcs - Maguro katsu maki, abundantly filled with tuna, features breaded and deep-fried tuna as a crispy centerpiece. Alongside vinegared rice and seaweed, this sushi roll is generously packed with tuna, both inside and as toppings. Additional elements like avocado, cucumber, and spicy mayo contribute to its rich and flavorful profile, creating a satisfying fusion of textures and tastes

3069752.name: Salmon katsu Maki
3069752.description: 6 pcs - Salmon katsu maki is a sushi roll that incorporates salmon katsu as a key component. Salmon katsu involves salmon that is breaded and deep-fried to achieve a crispy texture. The roll typically includes vinegared rice, seaweed, and additional ingredients such as avocado, cucumber, or sweet teriyaki sauce

3069751.name: Naruto Maki
3069751.description: A unique fish cake roll with a signature pink spiral, often used in ramen & soup

3069749.name: Philadelphia Salmon Roll
3069749.description: 6 pcs - A Philadelphia salmon roll is a fusion sushi roll featuring smoked salmon, cream cheese, cucumber, and avocado. Combining traditional Japanese elements with flavors inspired by the Philadelphia roll, it offers a delightful blend of creaminess and smokiness, often served in sushi platters

3069753.name: Sweet Tiger Roll
3069753.description: 6 pcs - The Sweet Tiger Roll is a distinctive sushi roll without nori, featuring prawn, cheese, avocado, and a fried prawn inside. Drizzled with sweet soy sauce and topped with a crunchy element, it offers a fusion of savory, sweet, and crunchy flavors for a delightful sushi experience.

3069745.name: Crispy Chicken Fry Roll
3069745.description: 6 pcs - Crispy chicken fry sushi roll is a fusion delight, featuring vinegared rice, seaweed, and crispy fried chicken. Additional elements like vegetables and spicy mayo enhance the texture and flavor, providing a unique twist to the traditional sushi experience

3069748.name: Beef Bulgogi Roll
3069748.description: 6 pcs - Beef Bulgogi Roll is a fusion delight, featuring thinly sliced beef bulgogi, rice, and possibly vegetables rolled in seaweed. This creation combines the flavors of Korean barbecue with traditional Japanese sushi, offering a unique and savory experience.

3069743.name: Salmon Logs Crispy Roll
3069743.description: 6 pcs - Salmon Logs Crispy Roll: A fusion delight featuring avocado, salmon, and cheese inside, wrapped, fried to crispiness, and topped with honey mustard. The combination offers a unique blend of textures and flavors, from the richness of salmon and cheese to the creaminess of avocado, all enhanced by the sweet and tangy notes of honey mustard.

3069746.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
3069746.description: 6 Pcs - The Dragon of Fire Roll is a tantalizing sushi creation that sparks the senses. Inside, it boasts a fusion of avocado, cucumber, crab stick, and carrot. Topped with torched crab stick and carrot kima, the roll delivers a smoky and savory essence. Drizzled with spicy mayo and adorned with tobiko and green onions, this roll promises a fiery yet flavorful experience, combining creamy, crunchy, and torched elements for sushi enthusiasts.

3069754.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
3069754.description: 6 pcs - The Spicy Salmon Roll is a classic sushi favorite that packs a punch of flavor. Inside, it features fresh and succulent salmon combined with a spicy mayo sauce for heat. The roll may also include cucumber for added freshness. Wrapped in seaweed (nori) and vinegared rice, this roll offers a perfect balance of spiciness and the natural richness of salmon, making it a popular choice for sushi lovers.

3069742.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
3069742.description: 6 pcs - The Spicy Tuna Roll is a sushi favorite featuring a tantalizing blend of spicy tuna, spicy mayo, and sometimes cucumber or avocado. Wrapped in seaweed and vinegared rice, it delivers a perfect balance of heat and the rich flavor of tuna, making it a popular choice for sushi lovers.

3069755.name: Fresh Vegetable Roll
3069755.description: 6 pcs - The Fresh Vegetable Roll, rolled with rice paper, is a colorful and healthy sushi choice. Packed with crisp veggies like cucumber, carrot, lettuce, and avocado, it offers a light and refreshing texture. Served with a dipping sauce, it's a delightful option for those looking for a veggie-packed sushi experience.

3069747.name: Dragon Eye Roll
3069747.description: 6 pcs - The Dragon Eye Roll is a flavor-packed sushi delight, featuring boiled shrimp, tuna, avocado, salmon, and crab stick inside. Fried to a crispy perfection, it is topped with spicy mayo sauce, sriracha, and ebiko for a harmonious blend of savory, spicy, and crunchy elements. An indulgent and memorable sushi experience.

9830225.name: Sumo Roll
9830225.description: 1 pc - Consists of futomaki large rolls - tuna sashimi, salmon sashimi, crab & avocado rolled in roe, recommended with wasabi mayo drizzle

9830226.name: Rainbow California Roll
9830226.description: 1 pc - Consists of salmon, crabstick, tuna, nori sheet, avocade & cucumber

9830227.name: Torched Salmon Roll
9830227.description: 1 pc - Prepared with nori paper, sticky rice, slice cheese, crabstick, avocado, egg, cucumber, top side salmon & chili mayo

9830228.name: Hot Night Roll
9830228.description: 1 pc - Lobster shrimp roll topped with minced spicy tuna, batter fried crunches, spicy mayo & flamed torched to add perfect flame grilled taste

9830229.name: Green Dragon Roll
9830229.description: 1 pc - stuffed with Shrimp tempura, cucumber eel sauce, crunchies, topped with soft avocado slices

3069763.name: Rainbow California Roll
3069763.description: 6 pcs Prepared with crab stick, avocado, cucumber, mayonnaise wrapped with tuna, salmon, avocado topped with japanese mayo

3069761.name: Hot Night Roll
3069761.description: 6 pcs Lobster shrimp roll topped with minced spicy tuna, batter fried crunches, spicy mayo & flamed torched to add perfect flame grilled taste.

3069758.name: Torched Salmon Roll
3069758.description: 6 pcs Prepared with nori paper, sticky rice, slice cheese, crabstick, avocado, egg, cucumber, top side salmon & chili mayo

3069759.name: Green Dragon Roll
3069759.description: 6 pcs Stuffed with shrimp tempura, cucumber eel sauce, topped with soft avocado slices.

3069757.name: Tiger Roll
3069757.description: 6 pcs Lobster shrimp rolled in with avocado, philadelphia drizzled with a flavorful sauce

3069762.name: Torched Crab Roll
3069762.description: 6 pcs Sushi roll with crab filling, top lightly torched

3069760.name: California Roll
3069760.description: 6 pcs Shredded crabstic, cucumber & avocado rolled in a classic rice outside nori, sprinkled with sesame seed.

3069725.name: Jajangmyeon With Beef
3069725.description: Jajangmyeon with beef is a tasty twist on the classic Korean-Chinese dish. Featuring chewy noodles smothered in a savory black bean sauce, this variation includes stir-fried beef for added richness and depth of flavor.

3069724.name: Jajangmyeon With Chicken
3069724.description: Jajangmyeon with Chicken is a tasty twist on the classic Korean-Chinese dish. Featuring chewy noodles smothered in a savory black bean sauce, this variation includes stir-fried chicken for added richness and depth of flavor.

3069722.name: Vegetable Fried Noodles

3069727.name: Japchae With Chicken
